title: Room2Room: Enabling Life-Size Telepresence in a Projected Augmented Reality Environment
authors: Tomislav Pejsa; Julian Kantor; Hrvoje Benko; Eyal Ofek; Andrew Wilson
takeaway: Project a remote person into an existing seat at life size.
bullets: RGB-D capture and perspective-correct projection integrate person, task and reference spaces.

limitations: Projection surfaces and image quality constrain the illusion. Copies disappear during arbitrary walking; seating/standing affordances are manually labelled (pp.4–5).
